'''Non-visual composite radiation sensors''',<ref name="EP1VD" /> also known simply as '''Radiation Sensors''',<ref name="BftG">''[[Star Wars: Battles for the Galaxy]]''</ref> were a type of specialized [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] commonly used in [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Unlike traditional [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], the small [[Color/Legends|red]] composite radiation sensors were more effective, precise, and less likely to be distracted and hampered by light-based effects.<ref name="EP1VD" />
